description: This file defines an abstract controller class (BaseAdminController) within the OrangeHRM HRM system, primarily responsible for handling admin-related permission checks and setting data group permissions in a web application's context. It extends functionality from an abstract Vue controller and implements capability checking via user role management.

classes.name: BaseAdminController
classes.description: An abstract controller class handling admin permission checks and context setting for the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns an array of data groups used for permission checks; by default, returns an empty array.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks if the current user has read permissions for the specified data groups.

methods.name: setPermissionsForController
methods.description: Sets data group permissions into the Vue context for frontend use.
